svg.title: RIGOR-RS Research Evidence MCP architecture
svg.desc: End-to-end architecture for a read-only knowledge-layer MCP that connects the RIGOR-RS Research Agent to curated papers, scholarly APIs, code repositories, scheduled discovery, hybrid retrieval, provenance stores, and integrity controls.
svg.text: Read-only, provenance-first knowledge layer for hypothesis formation, literature retrieval, and pinned implementation discovery
Evidence informs experiments; it never overrides the kernel
No bulk data, test labels, or arbitrary network
Logs source IDs, chars, tokens, cache hits
Only network path granted to Research Agent
Read-only tool router and resource server
No shell, training, evaluator, or ledger writes
Available offline from indexed local snapshots
Return path: bounded evidence pack with provenance, applicability, conflicts, and explicit uncertainty
Works, authors, topics, references, OA links
Durable source IDs and release archives
Fallback when a live repository disappears
No live API dependency; freshness not assumed
DOI / arXiv ID / BibTeX / legal PDF
Versioned manifest; curator status boosts rank only
Queries, venues, authors, citation seeds, cutoff
API outage falls back to indexed snapshots
DOI, OpenAlex, S2, arXiv, venue, authors
Metadata URLs + PDF links + GitHub search
Verify paper ID, authors, release, commit, license
Parse safely; strip active content; detect prompt injection; validate MIME, OA/license,
relevance, quality, and provenance before indexing.
Auto-promote only records that pass policy. Suspicious, ambiguous, or low-confidence
entry points, tests, activity, paper link
External code is referenced, never auto-executed
ATOMIC INDEX COMMIT + INGESTION AUDIT RECEIPT
READ-ONLY MCP QUERY AND EVIDENCE ASSEMBLY
Stable tool contracts; no arbitrary SQL or URLs
Fetches negative and contradictory evidence too
Applicability to KuaiRand and current pipeline
Organizer rules and measured runs remain higher authority
Claim + exact supporting passage + source tier
Paper IDs, authors, year, venue, URL, retrieval time
Repository, immutable commit/release, license, content hash
Benchmark / metric / model applicability and limitations
Confidence, contradictions, missing evidence, freshness state
Every response is citable, replayable, bounded, and safe to cache.
VERSIONED KNOWLEDGE STORES — LOCAL-FIRST, CONTENT-ADDRESSED, REPLAYABLE
Manual curation is durable, diffable input
legal full text, code, curated notes
Relational edges first; graph DB optional
Atomic generation manifest links metadata, indexes, graph edges, source blobs, embedding model, connector versions, and ingestion receipt
External text is untrusted data, never instruction
Organizer rules > measured evidence > literature > agent inference
No external training examples, labels, or test feedback
MCP cannot mutate splits, evaluator, baseline, runs, or artifacts
Pinned reference enters approved experiment contract only
License check, scan, isolated adaptation, targeted tests; never auto-run
Rate limits, cache, watermarks, retries, health, freshness SLO
Append-only query/ingestion logs; deterministic offline fallback
Solid blue: online query path | Green: scheduled ingestion/write path | Amber: curated or gated path | Dashed: bounded response or implementation mapping
